The Mysuru City Corporation will conduct a Special Praja Seva e-Aasthi campaign on October 28, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., at the Old Council Hall to provide fast and convenient e-Aasthi services to the public.
Applications received in the Praja Seva e-Aasthi campaign would be processed within 72 hours. After verification and spot inspection, eligible applicants would obtain their e-Aasthi on October 31 at 4 p.m., according to the press release issued by the MCC.
Property owners within the MCC limits can apply by submitting the prescribed documents. The corporation staff would assist applicants with submitting applications and uploading documents online. Applicants would receive an acknowledgement upon submission of their application.
For A-Khata properties, applicants must submit their registered sale deed, gift deed or any other registered document establishing ownership of the property, an encumbrance certificate, property tax payment receipt showing full payment of property tax for the current financial year, a recent passport-size photograph of the property owner, the owner’s Aadhaar Card, and a photograph of the property.
For B-Khata properties, applicants must submit registered ownership documents executed before September 10, 2024, an encumbrance certificate, a property tax payment receipt showing the full payment of property tax for the current financial year, Record of Rights, Tenancy, and Crops (RTC), a recent passport-size photograph of the property owner, the owner’s Aadhaar Card, and a photograph of the property.
Property owners must compulsorily bring their mobile phone linked to their Aadhaar card to complete OTP based verification during the e-Aasthi application process. The e-Aasthi fee would be ₹175.
Details regarding the application form, required documents and other procedures would be made available on the official Mysuru City Corporation website from Saturday, October 24, 2026, onwards, according to the press note issued by the MCC.
